name: manual_10b287
claim: Before merging or reopening a stale branch, follow the established orama git skills: fresh worktree from origin/main (using-git-worktrees), diff only the branch's true unique contribution against current main — never file-by-file merge of a long-drifted branch (git-history-surgery / branch-local-review-remediation). PR #280 (cursor/inline-comment-resolution-09ea) was an expensive exercise for nothing: ~12 commits of merge noise when only 2 memory lessons were unique; closed in favor of PR #284 after reset-to-main extraction. This class of waste is preventable if the agent reads and follows the skills first.

decisions.notes: Concrete incident 2026-07-24/25: PR #280 accumulated merge conflicts, stash-pop reverts, and superseded file edits across coordination scripts and plan docs — all already on main or structurally stale. The correct pattern (documented in orama using-git-worktrees + git-history-surgery) is: isolated worktree, branch from origin/main, cherry-pick or checkout only files proven unique via merge-base diff. Canonical skills: orama-system bin/orama-system/skills/using-git-worktrees/SKILL.md, bin/orama-system/skills/git-history-surgery/SKILL.md; PT .agent/references/branch-local-review-remediation.md. Example supersession: github.com/diazMelgarejo/Perpetua-Tools/pull/280 closed → pull/284.
